user.title: City
user.description: Enter at least 3 characters of the city name.

city.title: Select city
city.description: Select the correct city from Tauron’s address list.

street.title: Select street
street.description: Select a street. To change the query, check Search again and continue.

street_search.title: Search street
street_search.description: Enter at least 3 characters of the street name without a building number. Tauron limits results to 150 entries; use a more specific query if needed.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve valid Tauron data. Try again.
error.no_streets: Tauron returned no streets for this city. Choose another city.

init.title: Change monitoring
init.description: Set how often to fetch Tauron notices (5–1440 minutes). Default: 60 minutes. Saving reloads the integration and fetches data. The active outage sensor still switches at the previously fetched start and end times.

error.invalid_interval: Enter a number of minutes between 5 and 1440.
